plan.RM_choice: new fixed-step RM chosen for lower audited logged-event RMSE and calibration gap; old RM better MAE retained as sensitivity evaluator, not independent ground truth
plan.optimization: Fresh AdamW/scaler for all changing policies; same initial weights. FP16 forward FP32 loss. Fixed LAST checkpoint; no selection earlystop.
plan.training_contexts: Same pre-generated user/group train-contained day anchors for ALL arms. Matches joint-SFT loss; narrower support than original unrestricted group sampler; explicit run-level adaptation.
plan.continued_SFT: Same .5 next CE + .5 unique known day-positive meanCE; fallback nextCE if empty
plan.RL: On-policy H1 REINFORCE, action-independent EMA baseline (update AFTER step), exact KL(pi||frozen reference). No reward standardization.
plan.evaluation: selection only, all warm users for exact expected rewards/KL, active positive subset for unchanged NDCG. Same 50k catalog full support.
plan.analytic: H1 q(a|h)*exp(r/beta) normalized for each of4reward/beta, fixed RM and same queries
plan.H5: 64 warm users selected seed20261033 before future-label filtering, sampled5recommendations appended as ITEM TOKENS ONLY. Not user acceptance. No made-up elapsed times.
plan.uncertainty: Paired user bootstrap2000seed42; relevance preservation requires lower95bound of mean(NDCGpi-.95*NDCGref)>=0, not just point estimate
limits: Multiple previously explored selection, not independent confirmation
Alternate RM shares source logs, so agreement is not causal validation
Same update/context counts, actual compute differs; report per arm
H1 analytic control is pointwise reward proxy optimum, not true optimal recommender or H5 optimum

data_support.target_sampling: uniform eligible user, then group, then in-catalog event
